profile.role_note: Free 4-star quick-swap sub-DPS; Outro grants 38% Basic Attack DMG.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free 4-star and the best quick-swap sub-DPS for Basic Attack carries; build her, don't pull for her — she comes from any Convene banner.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Emerald of Genesis (or Overture) + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Impermanence Heron in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Glacio DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and prioritize Energy Regen in substats over damage so her Liberation is up every rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Standard-banner 5-star; good overall stats and helps meet her ER requirement. Not a signature — she has none as a 4-star.

ranked_weapons.name: Overture
ranked_weapons.note: Good 4-star alternative; Energy Regen substat plus Concerto Energy on Resonance Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Commando of Conviction
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% substat with an Intro-triggered ATK buff.

ranked_weapons.name: Lunar Cutter
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% substat with stacking ATK on entry.

ranked_weapons.name: Sword of Night
ranked_weapons.note: ATK buff on Intro; usable filler.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: The classic sub-DPS buffer set: Energy Regen for her rotations and an ATK buff for the incoming Resonator on Outro. Heron adds Resonance Energy and more ATK.

echo_sets.name: Freezing Frost
echo_sets.note: Damage-oriented setup for a Glacio-focused sub-DPS; sacrifices team buffs.

echo_sets.name: Freezing Frost + Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: General damage placeholder while farming a full set.

stat_priorities.note: Balance Crit for her solid personal damage.
Glacio DMG on both; swap one to Energy Regen if her Liberation isn't cycling.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; prioritize ER in substats over damage so her Liberation is up per rotation

teams.name: Premium: Camellya + Sanhua + Shorekeeper

members.name: Camellya
members.note: On-field Havoc DPS with self-buffs; her spinning combo benefits from Sanhua's Outro.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Her Outro grants the next character 38% Basic Attack DMG Amplified; minimal on-field time.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm buffs and healing; Verina is the documented support replacement.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm and Outro into Sanhua, who immediately uses skill and Liberation, detonates her Ice Structures with Heavy Attack: Detonate, then swaps to Camellya at full Concerto for her full combo. Shorekeeper detonates Stellarealm at the end.

teams.name: Alternative: Luuk Herssen + Sanhua + Mornye

members.name: Luuk Herssen
members.note: Premier Tune Strain DPS; Sanhua is his best 4-star sub-DPS.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Basic Attack DMG amplification funnelled onto Luuk.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: All-DMG amplification and increased Off-Tune Buildup Rate; Shorekeeper is the documented replacement.

teams.rotation: Mornye runs her support sequence, Sanhua quick-swaps in for her Outro buff, then Luuk takes an extended Tune Strain on-field window with both supports' buffs funnelled onto him.
